voicePipeline.title: From your voice to something you can use.
voicePipeline.subtitle.mac: On Mac, TypeWhisper joins capture, transcription, workflows, and delivery into a dependable flow that starts with a hotkey.
voicePipeline.subtitle.windows: On Windows, the same flow runs from a global hotkey through local recognition to output shaped for the current app or website.
voicePipeline.subtitle.ios: On iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch, the flow can start in the app, keyboard, a Shortcut, or widget and finish in a text field or your Inbox.
voicePipeline.capture.title: Capture
voicePipeline.capture.description.mac: Hotkeys, microphone, files, or calendar-aware meeting recordings.
voicePipeline.capture.description.window: Global hotkeys, recorder, files, and watched folders.
voicePipeline.capture.description.ios: App, voice keyboard, Apple Watch, Shortcuts, widgets, or files.
voicePipeline.transcribe.title: Transcribe
voicePipeline.transcribe.description.mac: Local engines such as WhisperKit, Parakeet, and Apple Speech, or cloud providers you deliberately choose.
voicePipeline.transcribe.description.win: Local models for everyday work and optional engines through integrations.
voicePipeline.transcribe.description.ios: Live text with on-device engines or optional cloud providers.
voicePipeline.shape.title: Shape
voicePipeline.shape.description.mac: Workflows, translation, Whisper Mode, and app-aware formatting.
voicePipeline.shape.description.windows: Workflows, app and website rules, dictionary, and snippets.
voicePipeline.shape.description.ios: Profiles, local translation, Smart Edit, and structured drafts.
voicePipeline.deliver.title: Deliver
voicePipeline.deliver.description.mac: Insert, copy, save, or trigger integrations and local APIs.
voicePipeline.deliver.description.window: Insert into the target, export, or automate through the API and CLI.
voicePipeline.deliver.description.ios: Return to the text field, review History and Inbox, or sync across devices.
voicePipeline.note: On-device processing remains the default. Cloud providers are optional.
features.mac.title: What macOS 1.6 changes day to day.
features.mac.subtitle: The current stable release combines faster capture with workflows, meeting automation, Backup & Restore, and expanded integrations.
features.mac.private.title: Local first, providers by choice.
features.mac.private.description: Process speech with local engines and no telemetry. Cloud ASR and LLM providers are used only after you configure and select them.
features.mac.dictation.title: Faster, more resilient capture.
features.mac.dictation.description: Lower startup latency, stronger audio capture, live transcript updates, and a clear recording indicator support everyday dictation.
features.mac.prompts.title: Workflows instead of cleanup.
features.mac.prompts.description: Polish dictation, format meeting notes, translate text, or run follow-up steps through your own workflow rules.
features.mac.profiles.title: Integrations, backup, and CLI providers.
features.mac.profiles.description: Manage add-ons and authenticated CLI providers centrally, and protect settings with Backup & Restore.
features.mac.transcription.title: Files, history, and automation.
features.mac.transcription.description: Transcribe audio and video, search results, and connect the recorder, dictionary, or workflows through local APIs.
features.windows.title: A complete Windows workflow.
features.windows.subtitle: Windows 1.0.9 combines system-wide dictation with reliable insertion, files, workflows, integrations, and local automation.
features.windows.private.title: Local models without a cloud requirement.
features.windows.private.description: Use local engines on CPU or with supported acceleration. Optional cloud engines remain a deliberate choice.
features.windows.dictation.title: Dictation with clear feedback.
features.windows.dictation.description: Global hotkeys, selectable capture modes, the overlay, and reliable clipboard or direct insertion guide each dictation.
features.windows.prompts.title: App and website rules.
features.windows.prompts.description: Assign workflows by app, website, or combined rules and control formatting and destination behavior.
features.windows.profiles.title: Integrations and authenticated CLI workflows.
features.windows.profiles.description: Install speech and LLM integrations, manage models, and use signed-in CLI providers for prompt workflows.
features.windows.transcription.title: Files, watch folders, API, and CLI.
features.windows.transcription.descripti: Process individual files or full queues and automate recurring work through local interfaces.
features.private.title: Private by default.
features.private.description: Run speech-to-text locally on your desktop with no telemetry, no subscriptions, and no mandatory cloud dependency.
features.dictation.title: Faster dictation.
features.dictation.description: Use multiple global hotkeys per action, stronger capture paths, and lower startup latency for daily dictation.
features.prompts.title: More controllable workflows.
features.prompts.description: Reorder workflows with drag and drop, run watch-folder jobs, and override the engine or model per dictation.
features.profiles.title: Integrations and models.
features.profiles.description: Install official, community, and manual plugins in the new hub, with downloaded local models managed in one place.
features.transcription.title: Files, APIs, and automation.
features.transcription.description: Transcribe files, automate watch folders, and control recorder or dictionary behavior through local HTTP APIs.
features.ios.title: Private speech-to-text on iPhone and iPad.
features.ios.subtitle: Dictate in the app or from the TypeWhisper keyboard, organize reusable profiles and snippets, and keep local processing under your control.
features.ios.private.title: Private by default.
features.ios.private.description: Use WhisperKit, Apple Speech, or Parakeet on your device, with optional cloud engines only when you choose them.
features.ios.dictation.title: A voice keyboard for other apps.
features.ios.dictation.description: Dictate into text fields across iOS, switch profiles from the keyboard, and expand reusable snippets.
features.ios.prompts.title: Smart profiles and translation.
features.ios.prompts.description: Choose languages, models, translation targets, whisper mode, and formatting behavior for each purpose.
features.ios.profiles.title: Your workflows, organized.
features.ios.profiles.description: Keep recording profiles, engines, and output choices ready for the way you work.
features.ios.transcription.title: Files, History, and Capture Inbox.
features.ios.transcription.description: Transcribe audio and video, then collect Watch recordings, Quick Dictations, and failed captures in one reviewable Inbox.
premiumFeatures.title: iCloud sync and a dictionary that learns.
premiumFeatures.subtitle: A Commercial license unlocks the two advanced features built for people who use TypeWhisper all day: Cloud Folder Sync and Automatic Correction Learning.
premiumFeatures.screenshotAlt: TypeWhisper Premium settings with correction learning and Cloud Folder Sync
premiumFeatures.sync.title: Cloud Folder Sync
premiumFeatures.sync.description: Sync dictionaries and snippets through your own iCloud Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, Syncthing, or custom folder.
premiumFeatures.sync.item1: Keep the same dictionary on every desktop
premiumFeatures.sync.item2: Sync snippets without a TypeWhisper account
premiumFeatures.sync.item3: Use the cloud folder you already trust
premiumFeatures.dictionary.title: Dictionary autocorrection
premiumFeatures.dictionary.description: TypeWhisper can learn confident corrections after insertion, then apply them automatically the next time recurring words, names, or typos appear.
premiumFeatures.dictionary.item1: Learns only from confident single-word edits
premiumFeatures.dictionary.item2: Fixes repeated names, jargon, and misspellings
premiumFeatures.dictionary.item3: Works alongside the existing dictionary pipeline
premiumFeatures.licenseNote: Premium features require an active Commercial license. The core app stays open source and local-first.
premiumFeatures.ios.title: Sync, Inbox, and smarter corrections.
premiumFeatures.ios.subtitle: TypeWhisper Premium adds correction learning, structured drafts, and selectable sync for dictionary, snippets, History, and Capture Inbox.
premiumFeatures.ios.screenshotAlt: TypeWhisper dictionary and correction learning on iPhone
premiumFeatures.ios.sync.title: The cloud location you choose
premiumFeatures.ios.sync.description: Sync through automatic iCloud or a folder selected with Apple's Files picker. Content does not pass through the TypeWhisper entitlement service.
premiumFeatures.ios.sync.item1: Keep dictionary and snippets aligned between iPhone and iPad
premiumFeatures.ios.sync.item2: Optionally sync History and Capture Inbox text and metadata
premiumFeatures.ios.sync.item3: Transfer audio only for new entries and only after you enable it
premiumFeatures.ios.dictionary.title: Improve and structure
premiumFeatures.ios.dictionary.descripti: Improve a fresh transcript, confirm trusted corrections, and shape recordings into reviewable drafts.
premiumFeatures.ios.dictionary.item1: Review original and processed text side by side
premiumFeatures.ios.dictionary.item2: Learn names and specialist terms from confirmed changes
premiumFeatures.ios.dictionary.item3: Create email drafts with a subject and body
premiumFeatures.ios.licenseNote: Core local dictation, dictionary, and snippet features remain available without an account or subscription.

engineComparison.title: Choose your engine
engineComparison.subtitle.mac: Six speech engines - three built-in, more via add-ons.
engineComparison.subtitle.other: Two speech recognition engines. All run entirely on-device.
engineComparison.subtitle.ios: Three on-device engines for iPhone and iPad. Optional cloud providers remain a deliberate choice.
engineComparison.cloudHint: Additional engines (Qwen3 ASR, Groq Whisper, OpenAI Whisper) are available as
engineComparison.mac.engine1.name: WhisperKit
engineComparison.mac.engine1.description: Apple-optimized Whisper models. Best for multilingual use and streaming preview.
engineComparison.mac.engine2.name: Parakeet TDT v3
engineComparison.mac.engine2.description: NVIDIA's latest TDT architecture. Extremely fast transcription for European languages with excellent accuracy.
engineComparison.mac.engine3.name: Apple SpeechAnalyzer
engineComparison.mac.engine3.description: Apple's native speech recognition. No manual model downloads - models are managed by macOS. Requires macOS 26+.
engineComparison.win.engine1.name: Parakeet TDT 0.6B
engineComparison.win.engine1.description: NVIDIA's TDT architecture optimized for ONNX Runtime. Fast transcription for European languages, CPU-only.
engineComparison.win.engine2.name: Canary 180M Flash
engineComparison.win.engine2.description: Compact multilingual model with built-in translation. Supports EN, DE, FR, and ES.
engineComparison.ios.engine1.name: WhisperKit
engineComparison.ios.engine1.description: Apple-optimized Whisper models. Best for multilingual use and streaming preview.
engineComparison.ios.engine2.name: Apple Speech
engineComparison.ios.engine2.description: Apple's native speech recognition. No model downloads needed - fast and reliable.
engineComparison.ios.engine3.name: Parakeet TDT v3
engineComparison.ios.engine3.description: Fast on-device recognition for supported European languages with a downloaded model.
